title: Value for money and purchase cost
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss the G60’s value proposition and purchase cost, with clear praise for strong value in some fragments and many other mentions that reference money without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G60 as good value for money, citing safety, comfort, efficiency, power, and a premium-feeling experience at a lower price.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention having money, paying a lot, possible extra cost, being cheated out of money, or a value-for-money ratio without enough context to classify sentiment toward the vehicle.

limitations: The sample is small and many fragments are too brief or context-poor to determine sentiment.
Some undetermined fragments may refer to personal finances or external costs rather than the vehicle’s value itself.
One positive fragment links cost-saving to durability impressions, which is harder to interpret cleanly within a value-for-money theme.
